name: Beat Up Dummies Simulator
desc:
Beat up dummies with a variety of weapons and combos to achieve blows which can be used to unlock better weapons to beat up dummies (and players) with. Defeat bosses and complete quests to unlock unique special weapons to further enhance your combative abilities.
Group for questions/updates: https://www.roblox.com/groups/10406903/Funny-Combat-Group#!/about

Notes:
- DELETING BADGES OBTAINED FROM THIS GAME MAY ERASE DATA.
- IF YOUR DATA IS RESET, PLEASE LEAVE & REJOIN IMMEDIATELY
- This game is developed by only one person. Updates may take a while or longer than anticipated.
- It's suggested, but not mandatory to play on PC. Playing on other devices may be difficult.
- Some updates/fixes may be imperfect. This game is prone to bugs and oversights.
- Yes, I am aware there are games with similar names to this one. This game is not an attempt to rip-off those of similarity to it.

Special thanks to those who helped with ideas, testing updates, and reporting bugs.
